implemented.one_holder: Reuse the existing _PreloadCustodyV1 and _RESOURCE_SEAL. Controller role retains its actual canonical suspended target. Received role has target=None and cannot borrow or reconstruct a controller's local object. No second score/qualification token exists.
implemented.receiver: Default-OFF receive_inherited_preload_v1 accepts four local handle locations plus a caller-owned private client endpoint. Exact enabled Windows facade checks actual inherited flags and clears inheritance, retained target/parent kernel identities, actual client-end server PID, root-event liveness, same held FileID/volume/fullpath/hash and before/after parent/root continuity. It registers only the same local verified holder and local receiver object.
implemented.transfer: Windows facade transfer_readback recognizes only its exact registered record, owner and current receiver PID. Public dict/foreign owner/closed resource cannot substitute. Parent birth/peer, target/FileID/hash and root revocation are freshly checked under owner then facade locks. A new received holder remains source-unqualified regardless of local success.
implemented.cleanup: Original holder.close clears owner qualification/cache before CloseHandle, closes only acquired local duplicates/private control resources and retains any unknown release for retry. Registry entries disappear after all their handles close. Actual runtime process/job/native-server handles are never owned or closed here.
implemented.exact_birth: Local kernel type accepts full ISO7 only if integer FILETIME matches exactly, including the seventh 100ns digit. Original CIM/microsecond strings still must equal exact FILETIME; no rounding/float/current-timezone fallback. Global environment parser remains unchanged. Existing _LoadedNativeProviderV1 appends optional game_creation_filetime; the unique issuer carries the validated exact integer.
implemented.source_guard: Received holder starts _preload_source_verified=False. Unique existing issuer explicitly refuses it before Native endpoint/module observation. No source-promotion API was implemented. Local staging success is not canonical preload origin or Native adoption.
